deadline.lore.cartas_anselmo.1:
12 August 1961

Monsignor,

The Bertolotti girl is not ill. She speaks with a voice that is not hers and answers in Latin questions I have not yet asked.

I ask your permission to continue.

Fr. Anselmo Ruiz
Our Lady of Carmel
deadline.lore.cartas_anselmo.2:
14 August 1961

Fourth night. It calls itself LEMAZA and writes it on the walls with its nails. It says its true name is read backwards.

I got it out of the girl. I could not get it out of the house. We walled up the room with brick and lime.

A.
deadline.lore.cartas_anselmo.3:
16 August 1961

Mrs Bertolotti,

Do not open the basement room. Ever. If the girl names it again, do not answer her. Do not speak of it out loud.

It listens. It listens to everything.

May God forgive me.
Fr. Anselmo
deadline.lore.cuaderno_lucia.1:
MY FRIEND IS CALLED LEMAZA
MY FRIEND IS CALLED LEMAZA
MY FRIEND IS CALLED LEMAZA

He lives in my wardrobe. In the daytime he isn't there. At night he sits at the foot of my bed and watches me sleep.
deadline.lore.cuaderno_lucia.2:
Lemaza is very tall. To look at me he has to fold all the way down, like a coat hanger.

He told me not to tell anyone. That if I talk out loud, she hears.
deadline.lore.cuaderno_lucia.4:
He says Nona was his once before, when she was little like me. That a priest came and took her away from him, and they locked him downstairs.

That now he has come back for her.
deadline.lore.cuaderno_lucia.5:
I asked him what he is going to do with us.

He laughed with Nona's mouth.
deadline.lore.cuaderno_lucia.6:
LEMAZA LEMAZA LEMAZA
LEMAZA LEMAZA
LEMAZA
AZAMEL
deadline.lore.cuaderno_lucia.7: I KNOW YOU ARE READING THIS

deadline.lore.fotos_1961.3:
EL DIARIO DEL SUR - 18 August 1961

PRIEST WHO TENDED THE LAS GLICINAS GIRL IS DEAD

Father Anselmo Ruiz, 41, was found dead in the parish house of Our Lady of Carmel.

Neighbours on Las Glicinas lane say that for four nights prayers were heard from the Bertolotti family's basement, "as if someone were saying them backwards".

The girl, aged 8, is well.

deadline.lore.misal_anselmo.1:
RITUALE ROMANUM
De exorcizandis obsessis a daemonio


It does not answer to its name.
It answers to its name backwards.

Name it, and it hears.
Hear it, and it comes back.

A.

deadline.sms.clara.coro: The choir girls are still singing. Backwards.
deadline.sms.clara.hora: Sorry about the hour. I can't call you. She listens.
deadline.sms.clara.luz: If you see her, shine a light on her. Light burns her.
deadline.sms.clara.no_corra: And never run in the halls. Never.
deadline.sms.marta.arriba: I don't know who is upstairs.
deadline.sms.marta.cuaderno: Lucía writes in a notebook. It isn't her handwriting.

deadline.sms.marta.cubiertos: Eat slowly. Don't let the cutlery make a sound.
deadline.sms.marta.cura: In '61 a priest came. He didn't finish.
deadline.sms.marta.fotos_nono: In Nono's study there are photos from '61. Look at them.
deadline.sms.marta.luces_auto: Turn off the car lights when you get here.
deadline.sms.marta.luz_bano: Don't turn on the bathroom light.
deadline.sms.marta.no_coma: Don't eat what she serves you.
deadline.sms.marta.no_es_usted: It isn't you in the hallway.
deadline.sms.marta.no_llame: Please come tonight. Don't call. DON'T CALL. She hears everything.
deadline.sms.marta.no_mire: Don't look her in the eyes.
deadline.sms.marta.no_pare: Don't stop on the road. Not for anything.
deadline.sms.marta.no_respire: If you hear her close, don't breathe.
deadline.sms.marta.no_sola: Don't leave her alone with the kids.
deadline.sms.marta.no_soy_yo: I didn't write 'come down' to you.
deadline.sms.marta.numero: Good evening. Father Ignacio gave me your number.
deadline.sms.marta.pantalla: Press the phone against your chest when it buzzes.
deadline.sms.marta.perdon: I'm sorry I made you come.
deadline.sms.marta.perro: The dog hasn't come into the house since Tuesday.
deadline.sms.marta.perro_parado: If you see the dog standing on two legs, don't look at it.
deadline.sms.marta.quien_camina: We're all in bed. Who is walking?
deadline.sms.marta.ropero: At night I hear her talking to someone in the wardrobe.
deadline.sms.marta.suegra: It's my mother-in-law. She isn't herself any more.
deadline.text.colegio.diario: 21/6. I hear them singing backwards. They did it without me. There were seven. THE BOOK SAYS EIGHT.
deadline.text.colegio.legajo: Religious name: Sister Maria of the Agony. Secular name: CLARA INES BUSTOS. Discharged: 22/6/1984. "Not on record. Not to be searched for."
deadline.text.colegio.oracion.1: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.
deadline.text.colegio.oracion.2: Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
deadline.text.colegio.oracion.3: Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
deadline.text.colegio.reglamento: 1. Silence. 2. In this school we walk. No running. 3. Every voice will be heard.
deadline.text.colegio.reglas: LIGHT BURNS HER. IF YOU MAKE NOISE, SHE ALREADY HEARD YOU. NO RUNNING IN THE HALLS.
deadline.text.colegio.silencio: Silence. Fifteen seconds. Not a word.
